cases.observation: Instrument agreement and calibration depend on dose-rate regime; preflight functional tests alone did not guarantee low-dose accuracy.
cases.strategy_inference: Require quantity/range-specific calibration and independent measurement checks.
cases.limit: Historical cislunar dosimetry, not a local polar dose or adopted modern limit.

cases.observation: Real-time monitoring, specialist assessment and reporting cadence were part of radiation decision support.
cases.strategy_inference: Use timely qualified monitoring and event/context review, not a calendar-average safety shortcut.
cases.limit: Reporting recommendations are historical; no new cadence or dose threshold is adopted.

cases.observation: Raised shroud sections and deposited dust were considered contributors to abnormal instrument temperature.
cases.strategy_inference: Include deployment and contamination in thermal-response checks.
cases.limit: The report's causal explanation is qualified; sensor temperature is not ambient lunar temperature.

cases.observation: The heat-flow experiment was inoperative after cable failure despite deployment work.
cases.strategy_inference: Separate deployment success and equipment function from environmental observations.
cases.limit: Failure evidence does not supply a missing subsurface temperature measurement.

cases.observation: Seismic observations included crew/rover activity, spacecraft impact and deliberate active-source signals.
cases.strategy_inference: Attribute operational and natural sources before counting independent environmental events.
cases.limit: No local south-polar recurrence or structural demand follows.

cases.observation: Residual atmospheric-experiment peaks, background ramps and sunrise effects were complicated by outgassing and instrument behaviour.
cases.strategy_inference: Track background, source identity and operating state before interpreting abundance.
cases.limit: Not a numerical correction for LADEE or proof of uncontaminated surface gas.

cases.observation: Daytime thermal problems restricted ejecta-instrument operation to selected illumination periods.
cases.strategy_inference: Treat operating duty cycle and missing observations as potentially state-dependent.
cases.limit: An unobserved interval is not zero impacts or a qualified quiet season.

cases.observation: EVA initiation and traverse planning depended on life-support instrumentation, contingency return and consumable reserves.
cases.strategy_inference: Define essential capability and recovery requirements before optional task preferences.
cases.limit: Historical configuration-specific numbers are not default base requirements.

cases.observation: Detailed normal-operation and moving-traverse communication provisions state different conditional loss-of-contact durations.
cases.strategy_inference: Preserve operating condition, exception and rule precedence; do not flatten the text to one universal outage cutoff.
cases.limit: Source p33 mentions five minutes while p51 describes approximately thirty minutes under moving-operation conditions; adoption/precedence remains unresolved for a new mission.

cases.observation: Contingency task budgets, return capability and rover battery thermal-management provisions were condition-specific.
cases.strategy_inference: Retain schedule slack, contingencies and temperature-dependent capability in operational planning.
cases.limit: No historical troubleshooting duration or battery temperature is adopted as a new limit.

cases.observation: Camera Sun/bright-object precautions, Sun/off thermal placement, blanket management and repeated dusting were equipment-specific.
cases.strategy_inference: Consider glare, thermal balance and maintenance together; darkness is not universally preferable.
cases.limit: The historical camera/communications configuration is not selected modern hardware.

cases.observation: Dust interference, equipment handling and feedwater depletion affected crew tasks and ingress timing.
cases.strategy_inference: Include human activity, contamination and consumable interactions rather than independent ambient-variable scores.
cases.limit: Retrospective synthesis and historical equipment; not a validated local degradation model.

cases.file: Operational Assessment of Apollo Lunar Surface EVA.pdf
cases.observation: Task reallocations and dust-related closeout competed with science time; actual consumable use often exceeded predictions.
cases.strategy_inference: Review activity/rate and duration contributions separately and retain maintenance/contingency time.
cases.limit: Related primary/secondary tables are not independent missions or fixed modern reserve multipliers.

cases.observation: The LM environmental-control architecture coupled atmosphere revitalization, oxygen/pressure, water, heat transport and electrical power.
cases.strategy_inference: Check coupled essential services, not isolated stock or environment values.
cases.limit: Historical two-person LM architecture is not an automatically selected base or crew profile.

cases.observation: Flight silver-zinc batteries and Earth one-g trainer nickel-cadmium batteries had different capacities and operational assumptions.
cases.strategy_inference: Keep hardware, chemistry, gravity/test environment and quantity identity; charge capacity is not energy without voltage/response.
cases.limit: Neither historical configuration becomes a modern default, and Earth-trainer results do not qualify lunar hardware.

cases.observation: Surface appearance and terrain interpretations varied with illumination and image geometry.
cases.strategy_inference: Preserve acquisition geometry and independent terrain support before operational interpretation.
cases.limit: Image brightness is not a numerical slope/soil-capacity or local irradiance threshold.

cases.observation: An editorial account links fuel-cell pump trouble, lost cooling and restricted reuse.
cases.strategy_inference: Investigate coupled cooling/power failures and corroborate secondary diagnoses against primary records.
cases.limit: The stated likely failure mechanism is not independently established here or transferable as a modern reliability rate.

cases.observation: Despite the filename, the cover identifies Apollo 17 (AS-512), not Apollo 7.
cases.strategy_inference: Use source identity and mission phase, not filenames, to determine applicability.
cases.limit: Planned operations are not postflight evidence or current operational requirements.
